climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: An Aragón DO grouped with Calatayud as Campo de Borja & Calatayud, in northwest Zaragoza province across 16 municipalities. It is a transition zone between the Ebro plains and the Iberian mountains, and Moncayo mountain creates a microclimate. Garnacha Tinta, Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon are among its allowed grapes.
